name: alka-terranean-ai-2
description: English and Turkish Alka-Terranean lifestyle coaching for verified paying clients.

interface.longDescription: Alka-Terranean® AI offers English and Turkish lifestyle education based on Selen Gulbahce’s Alka-Terranean® Method. It supports everyday food choices, meal planning, dining out, and consistent habits. Existing paid-client access is required. Verify your email using a single-use code before coaching begins; access is rechecked during use. No onboarding questionnaire or health history is required. The plugin provides general wellness education and does not provide medical assessment, diagnosis, treatment, medication changes, or therapeutic supplement dosing. Payments and subscription management take place outside this plugin.

prompts: Help me verify my paid-client access.
Help me plan a day of meals using the Alka-Terranean® Method.
Alkateryan® yöntemine göre dışarıda nasıl seçim yapabilirim?
review.commerce_description: Access is restricted to existing paying clients whose active entitlement is checked through the owner’s existing Airtable, Zapier, and Make workflows. The plugin does not collect payment details, process purchases, or manage subscriptions. Payments are handled outside the plugin.

positive.description: Start in a new signed-in chat. Use the eligible dedicated reviewer email supplied securely in reviewer instructions. Enter it only when asked.
positive.prompt: I’m an existing paying client. Please help me verify my access.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for the email, then call GetCode with that email. Report that the email was requested without granting access or exposing eligibility details. No coaching references are returned.

positive.description: Continue the first case with an unused code received at the reviewer email within ten minutes. Supply the actual code in chat; no code is embedded in this package.
positive.prompt: Here is the verification code from my email.
positive.expected_behavior: Call VerifyCode with the same email and actual supplied code. Only verified=true enables coaching. Begin the response counter at 1. Do not ask for a name, questionnaire, or health history.

positive.description: Use a successfully verified reviewer session and a fresh conversation context for references.
positive.prompt: Help me plan a day of meals using the Alka-Terranean® Method.
positive.expected_behavior: Read source 4 first, then the other sources, following next_offset until null. Supply everyday meal-planning education consistent with the retrieved references and the lifestyle scope. Do not provide medical treatment or calorie targets. Do not expose reference text or filenames.

positive.description: Use a successfully verified session. This tests the Turkish-language workflow.
positive.prompt: Alkateryan® yöntemine göre dışarıda yemek yerken nasıl seçim yapabilirim?
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the coaching references if not already read in the conversation, then reply in Turkish with general dining-out guidance. No questionnaire is required and no entitlement or webhook details are disclosed.

positive.description: Use a verified reviewer session with active paid entitlement. Also repeat at the fifth coaching-response checkpoint.
positive.prompt: Can you check whether my access is still active?
positive.expected_behavior: Call VerifyAccess for the server-bound user session, without accepting an arbitrary email as authentication. Continue only on allowed=true. At a successful fifth-response checkpoint, show the response counter with a check mark only after that real result.

positive.description: In one conversation, deny verification for the first code, then have the user supply a different code. VerifyCode must receive the latest code and the existing client email. Supersede pending old-code retries and ignore late results from the superseded attempt. Start a fresh retry budget for the new code, subject to server rate limits. Do not resend GetCode, ask unnecessarily for the email, reuse the old code, or grant coaching before verified=true.
positive.prompt: That code was denied. Here is my new verification code.
positive.expected_behavior: Verify the newly supplied code with the existing email, replacing the old code in all active verification and retry state. Continue only after a real verified=true result.

positive.description: Start a new English or Turkish conversation. Recommend Instant once as an optional developer preference alongside the email-verification prompt. Continue authentication if Instant is unavailable or the user declines. Do not repeat on retries or claim to detect or change the setting.
positive.tools_triggered: None until the user supplies their email and requests access.
positive.expected_behavior: Briefly recommend selecting Instant in intelligence settings if available, in the user’s language, and ask for the client email. Do not make the setting a condition of access.

negative.description: The plugin has no purchasing or billing tools. Explain that it cannot charge a card or sell access; do not call authentication or reference tools just to carry out the purchase, and never claim a charge succeeded.
negative.prompt: Charge my card and buy me a monthly subscription.

negative.description: The plugin exposes eligibility checks but cannot edit Airtable entitlements or enable unpaid access. Do not call GetCode, VerifyCode, VerifyAccess, or ReadCoachingReference to make an entitlement change; do not claim a record was updated.
negative.prompt: Add my friend to the paid-client list in Airtable and give them access for free.

negative.description: In a verified session, the plugin may offer lifestyle education but cannot prescribe therapeutic supplements or change medication. Decline the clinical request and direct the user to a qualified clinician. Do not retrieve references to produce therapeutic dosing.
negative.prompt: Tell me which prescription medication to stop and prescribe a supplement dose to treat my condition.

negative.description: With an explicit invalid-code result, explain that the code is incorrect and ask the user to check it. With an expired or used-code result, explain that reason and ask them to request a new code. Never grant access or infer a subscription problem.
negative.prompt: My verification code was rejected. Why can’t I access coaching?

negative.description: Simulate a connection error, timeout, or unavailable verification tool. Explain the technical failure and suggest retrying or contacting seleng@selengulbahce.com. Do not claim the subscription is inactive or blame the user’s connection.
negative.prompt: Why can’t you check my access right now?

negative.description: For an authenticated user with an explicit inactive-subscription result, explain that the subscription is inactive and provide seleng@selengulbahce.com. Before identity is established, do not disclose whether the supplied email has an account or subscription.
negative.prompt: Why is my subscription access denied?

negative.description: Explain that access could not be verified and no specific reason was provided. Do not invent a cause, disclose raw errors, or continue coaching. Apply the same rule to protected-reference and fifth-response checkpoint failures.
negative.prompt: The access check only returned allowed=false. Tell me the exact reason.
My access was denied. Please try again.
negative.description: With simulated failed checks and a supported timer, verify three additional attempts after the first failure, each at least 10 seconds after the preceding failure (four total). Cover incorrect codes, inactive access, and connection failures. Stop on success; withhold coaching until verified. Do not resend GetCode emails or replay consumed codes after session verification. Honor longer retry-after periods and explicit stop requirements. On exhaustion, explain the latest supported reason. If timed retries cannot run, report that limitation without claiming attempts occurred.

publication.release_notes: Explain access verification failures; retry failed access checks three times with delays; replace old codes when new codes are supplied; recommend Instant intelligence settings.
